**Holbæk** refers to **Holbæk Sygehus** (Holbæk Hospital), a healthcare institution in Denmark, and should not be confused with the geographic city of Holbæk. In the context of the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK) annual report, the hospital is evaluated across multiple clinical quality indicators regarding the treatment and management of atrial fibrillation patients. 

Holbæk Hospital operates within [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] [^src4]. During the reporting period of July 1, 2022, to June 30, 2023, the hospital was measured on [[indikator-2|Indikator 2]], which tracks the performance of echocardiography on newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation patients [^src2]. Holbæk successfully met the national standard for this indicator, achieving a compliance rate of 83.8% (95% CI: 80.3–86.9) among 512 eligible patients [^src2]. 

The hospital's performance is also documented across several other clinical indicators in the report's detailed hospital-level tables. For instance, it met the standard for early anticoagulation treatment (Indicator 1) with a 90.7% compliance rate [^src1], and for anticoagulation coverage two years post-diagnosis (Indicator 4a) with a 91.4% rate [^src3]. However, it did not meet the standard for the five-year post-diagnosis anticoagulation metric, recording an 83.4% compliance rate [^src4]. Additionally, the hospital reported a very low rate (0.6%) for the prevention of ischemic stroke via anticoagulation treatment (Indicator 5) [^src5].
